name: DDLC: Take Two!
source: A sequel mod that expands on the story of the original game. After a brief chat in the void, Monika and Sayori decide to give their world one last chance. Now armed with the knowledge that all the club members are sentient, a better result is all they can hope for. Sayori also retains her self-awareness, so Monika is a little less alone this time.
